ai_summary: Aequs Limited's Nomination and Remuneration Committee has approved the grant of 350,000 Employee Stock Options (ESOPs) under its ESOP 2025 plan, with an exercise price of INR 246.00 per option, based on the previous day's market price. This grant aims to incentivize and retain employees, but it introduces a potential dilution of existing shareholder equity if all options vest and are exercised. The action appears to be a standard, compliant compensation measure without immediate red flags.
